description: Speech recognition endpoint whose local-language models are fine-tuned on native-speaker data and tuned for regional accents and code-switching with English.

meta.note: The same endpoint also serves ~95 'common languages' through a general large language model (vendor not disclosed); only the Proto fine-tuned local-language models are listed in languages.
meta.translation: optional English translation of the transcript

name: Proto Voice API ASR

pricing.notes: Prepaid voice credits; 1 credit per successful TTS or ASR request (failed requests not charged). Graduated pay-as-you-go tiers on the Starter plan; 50 free credits for new workspaces. Same balance shared by /tts and /asr.

description: Text-to-speech endpoint whose local-language voices are built from native-speaker recordings rather than adapted English voices.

meta.excluded_languages: Oshiwambo and Urdu TTS are proxied to an external OmniVoice relay, not Proto-trained models
meta.gender_param: male|female (availability varies by language; Kinyarwanda female only)
